title: Hoplite launches cloud coding agents that work from task to pull request
friendlyTitle: Hoplite gives coding jobs to cloud AI workers
summary: YC-backed Hoplite gives each coding task an isolated cloud sandbox where an agent can inspect a repository, edit code, run tests, open a live preview and prepare a pull request. Teams can gate file edits, shell commands and pull-request actions behind approvals.
friendlySummary: Hoplite puts each coding task in its own safe cloud computer. The AI changes code, runs tests and waits for approval before opening a pull request.
whyItMatters: This is the emerging model for delegated software work: give an agent an outcome, let it verify its own changes in a real environment, then keep a human at the approval boundary. It may save engineering time on well-scoped fixes and maintenance tasks.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Developers can hand over clear tasks while still checking the final work before it is merged.
